technical.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02) Runtime:404-468为常规协议队列适配25%，共享状态可迁移50%；新颖性和简化25%，未解决已验证端到端约束故不升50%机制。

business.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) 桌面到移动接续workflow50%，交付任务仍相同25%；移动可达性50%，[Q03](#research-q03) 费用收益未知经济性25%。

recommendation.reason: 已有 DSH 长任务且能管理网关的个人用户可以关注 Whaleness 的移动继续方案。相比手机浏览器，它提供原生客户端与共享会话状态，但网关授权、真机恢复和写操作确认仍未固定核验。若断线后结果不明、重复提交或权限难判断，用户应断开手机并回到桌面处理。

scenario.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) README:7-45明确远程接续任务50%超过偶发便利；真实持续痛点未独立验证，未到75%。

advantage.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02) Runtime连接和Store投影解释原生接续增量，50%超过局部入口；最终体验和恢复未知不达75%。

evidence.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02) 客户端核心源码有依据超过0%；外部Gateway及双平台传输是关键缺口，25%不到50%。

cost.rationale: [Q03](#research-q03) 网关、凭据、网络和缓存需用户维护，25%有桌面退路超过0%，但写操作未知恢复不够50%。

# Whaleness > 通过 Mobile Gateway 远程访问 DSH 会话、Agent 任务与工作区的 Android 和 iOS 原生客户端。 ## 研究范围 - **仓库**：[Clarklevis1995/dsh-mobile](https://github.com/Clarklevis1995/dsh-mobile) - **版本号**：未声明（[固定提交 1fa7aa7e2d3f50379d37fba251fb6e774416703b](https://github.com/Clarklevis1995/dsh-mobile/tree/1fa7aa7e2d3f50379d37fba251fb6e774416703b)） - **版本日期**：2026-10-27（固定提交日期，北京时间；不是包发布日期） ## 结论状态 共享连接、队列和事件折叠有源码支持；真机、网关授权与端到端恢复未验证。 ## 洞察短评 - **用途**：个人DSH用户离开桌面后查看长任务、继续聊天并处理问题，最终结果仍在宿主验收。 - **亮点**：[Q01](#research-q01) 与 [Q02](#research-q02) 表明共享请求状态和会话投影可供两套原生界面复用，提供移动继续任务的组织方式；不证明同平台真机兼容。 - **思考**：[Q02](#research-q02) 传输发送不代表宿主收到或业务执行，关键Gateway与原生传输没有固定检查；[Q03](#research-q03) 后台保活亦有限。 - **建议**：[Q04](#research-q04) 提出按发送、接收、完成分层回执减少重复提交，未验证；若仍不能识别未知结果则否定。 采用建议：[Q04](#research-q04) 先固定Gateway和平台传输核验，只读非敏感任务比手机浏览器；当前观察。 ## 核心贡献 [Q01](#research-q01) 与 [Q02](#research-q02) 表明共享请求状态和会话投影可供两套原生界面复用，提供移动继续任务的组织方式；不证明同平台真机兼容。 ## 关键质疑 [Q02](#research-q02) 传输发送不代表宿主收到或业务执行，关键Gateway与原生传输没有固定检查；[Q03](#research-q03) 后台保活亦有限。 ## 重点创新推演与最小验证 [Q04](#research-q04) 提出按发送、接收、完成分层回执减少重复提交，未验证；若仍不能识别未知结果则否定。 受限网络核配对撤销、锁屏切网、消息回执和桌面对账；高影响写操作先不启用，未执行。 ## 场景与替代办法 个人DSH用户离开桌面后查看长任务、继续聊天并处理问题，最终结果仍在宿主验收。 手机浏览器访问DSH或回到桌面；原生移动交互与宿主执行分开判断。 ## 依赖与流程 | 依赖或条件 | 是否必需 | 用途 | 缺失或不满足时 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | Android7+或iOS16.1+ | 必需 | 原生客户端 | 设备不支持 | | DSH与Gateway>=0.11.1 | 必需 | 宿主协议与任务执行 | 无法连接或兼容未知 | | 网络和配对凭据 | 必需 | 访问指定桌面 | 断线或鉴权失败 | | 桌面语音插件 | 语音可选 | 转录 | 本轮未核语音链 | | 步骤 | 执行者与动作 | 成功判据或失败处理 | | --- | --- | --- | | 准备 | 用户固定网关版本与受限网络 | 配对到正确宿主 | | 发送 | 客户端组装消息与请求ID | 发送不等于执行完成 | | 核对 | 用户对比手机与桌面事件 | 未知先对账不盲重发 | | 退出 | 用户断开并撤销设备 | 回桌面WebUI | ## 成本与效果 | 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 首次使用 | 手机客户端和桌面网关 | 安装配对和网络配置 | 耗时未知 | | 持续使用 | 宿主模型、网络和本地缓存 | 监控连接和权限 | 省时与token未知 | | 失败恢复 | 重连与重复操作资源 | 桌面核结果和撤销凭据 | 端到端恢复未测 | | 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 | | --- | --- | --- | | 移动接续 | 共享连接和请求状态 | 真机可用与效率 | | 会话一致性 | 持久序列与瞬态分开处理 | 网关去重与跨端恢复 | ## 研究问题与完整回答 **插件研究总目标**：移动端怎样可靠继续DSH任务并辨认断线未知结果？ ### Q01 · 相对手机浏览器的具体增量和身份是什么？ **研究主题**：场景与需求、贡献与相对优势 #### 完整回答 Whaleness是第三方Android/iOS原生客户端，通过另一个Mobile Gateway插件连接桌面DSH；当前组件类型为client，不是DSH宿主插件。适合离开电脑时查看长任务、继续会话和处理人工问题的用户。相对手机浏览器或远程桌面，增量是平台原生交互、共享Kotlin状态逻辑及移动生命周期处理；模型执行、工具权限和文件操作仍在桌面宿主，不能把移动界面权限当手机本地沙盒。README列出多种能力，但本轮只确认消息与状态核心链，不以展示截图当真机验收。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 作者声明**：[README.md:7-11](https://github.com/Clarklevis1995/dsh-mobile/blob/1fa7aa7e2d3f50379d37fba251fb6e774416703b/README.md#L7-L11) 客户端任务定义。 ```text # Whaleness — A Third-Party Mobile Client for DeepSeek Harness **Native Android and iOS apps with core business logic shared through Kotlin Multiplatform.** Connect to DeepSeek Harness through Mobile Gateway to access workspaces, live conversations, Agent traces, plugins, scheduled tasks, and files from your phone, tablet, or foldable. ``` **依据 2 · 作者声明**：[README.md:32-45](https://github.com/Clarklevis1995/dsh-mobile/blob/1fa7aa7e2d3f50379d37fba251fb6e774416703b/README.md#L32-L45) 跨平台共享与独立Gateway依赖。
查看原文（14行） ```text Whaleness is an independently developed third-party native mobile client for DeepSeek Harness. Both Android and iOS apps use Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP): - `shared` is the source of truth for shared business state, including protocol handling, state machines, reducers, projections, and synchronization. - `androidApp` implements the Android app with Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, and OkHttp. - `DeepSeekHarnessMobile` builds the iOS interface with SwiftUI/UIKit and accesses shared logic through a Kotlin/Native framework. Both apps connect to Harness over WebSocket through [`dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway`](https://github.com/Clarklevis1995/dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway). Networking, secure storage, files, images, lifecycle handling, and background execution use native platform APIs. Business rules are consolidated in `shared/commonMain` wherever practical. ## Downloads and Prerequisites - **iOS**: [Join the TestFlight beta](https://testflight.apple.com/join/1Euwby6r). Supports iPhone and iPad running iOS / iPadOS 16.1 or later. - **Android**: [Download an APK from GitHub Releases](https://github.com/Clarklevis1995/dsh-mobile/releases). Requires Android 7.0 (API 24) or later. In-app update checks prefer the accelerated download source and verify downloaded packages. - **Desktop host**: Run DeepSeek Harness with **`dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway` 0.11.1 or later** installed and enabled. [`AppRelease/release-info.json`](AppRelease/release-info.json) defines the required minimum version. - **Voice input**: Enable the official Voice Input plugin in the desktop host's Plugins section, finish model download and initialization, and grant microphone access on the mobile device. ```
**依据 3 · 作者声明**：[README.md:89-102](https://github.com/Clarklevis1995/dsh-mobile/blob/1fa7aa7e2d3f50379d37fba251fb6e774416703b/README.md#L89-L102) 宿主权限与后台限制。
查看原文（14行） ```text - **Multiple hosts and sessions**: Save and switch between Gateway hosts with separate credentials. Browse, create, and switch workspaces; search, create, switch, and archive sessions. - **File cards and previews**: Open file cards directly from conversations, browse remote directories, and download files in verified chunks. Preview PDFs, images, and code, or share and open files with system apps. - **Markdown source / preview**: Browse code with syntax highlighting, line numbers, and horizontal scrolling for long lines. Switch Markdown files between source and rendered views, retaining each view's reading position. - **Plugin management**: Browse official and installed plugins, details, and runtime status. Install, enable, disable, and configure plugins where supported by the host. - **Scheduled tasks**: Browse tasks created in conversations, search and filter them, expand their rules, next execution time, and delivery information, and edit or delete tasks. - **Session and default settings**: Manage Agent presets, providers/models, reasoning effort, and Harness Agent permissions: `read-only`, `workspace-write`, and `danger-full-access`. These control the Agent on the host, not the phone's local filesystem. ### Native Device Experience - **Tablets and foldables**: Layouts adapt to the available window size on iPad, Android tablets, and foldables. Wide home screens use columns, conversations retain a comfortable reading width, and file previews resize with the window. Android layouts account for the folding hinge area. - **Themes and text size**: Light and dark appearances, plus system or manually adjusted app text size, with Harness's ocean, grid, and whale visual identity. - **iOS Live Activities and notifications**: Follow task progress, approvals, and completion on the Lock Screen and supported Dynamic Island devices, with system notifications for important updates. - **Secure device pairing**: Scan a WebUI QR code or enter pairing details manually. Long-lived credentials are stored in platform secure storage. - **Mobile lifecycle handling**: Neither app intentionally closes a healthy connection when backgrounded. Connections recover on returning to the foreground after a disconnect; manual disconnects do not trigger automatic reconnection. Android runs a foreground service only during active Agent turns. iOS uses the limited background execution time granted by the system and does not guarantee an indefinitely open WebSocket. ```
### Q02 · 消息、历史和断线状态如何处理？ **研究主题**：功能与机制、工程质量与复用 #### 完整回答 共享Runtime从按endpoint存储的凭据取token再连接，手动disconnect设置desiredConnection=false并取消恢复任务、清队列和关闭传输。sendMessage先检查空消息和附件限额，再把requestId等组装为GatewayRequest；sendRequestLocked要求已连接并按响应通道选择拒绝、FIFO或合并最新请求，发送成功仅表示transport接受，不代表宿主业务完成。ConversationStore对持久事件要求seq前进，瞬态stream走独立路径，避免同轮共享水位被误判重复；历史增量更新投影。可借鉴共享状态机和请求代际隔离，但未实查双平台原生传输及Gateway服务端，因此不能保证写命令断线时恰好一次执行。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[shared/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/clarklevis/dsh/shared/gateway/GatewayRuntime.kt:216-265](https://github.com/Clarklevis1995/dsh-mobile/blob/1fa7aa7e2d3f50379d37fba251fb6e774416703b/shared/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/clarklevis/dsh/shared/gateway/GatewayRuntime.kt#L216-L265) 凭据读取与明确手动断开。
查看原文（50行） ```text suspend fun connectStoredIfPaired(): Boolean = serialized { val stored = preferences.load() if (!stored.automaticallyConnect) return@serialized false if ( desiredConnection && endpoint == stored.endpoint && mutableState.value.connection in IDEMPOTENT_CONNECTION_STATES ) { return@serialized true } val token = runCatching { credentials.loadToken(stored.endpoint) }.getOrElse { failOpenLocked(ERROR_CREDENTIAL_ACCESS) return@serialized false } if (token.isNullOrBlank()) return@serialized false requireWebSocketEndpoint(stored.endpoint) cancelForegroundResumeLocked() lastConnectedEndpoint = null endpoint = stored.endpoint pairingCode = null isManualPairingAttempt = false desiredConnection = true reconnectBlocked = false reconnectJob?.cancel() recoveryDeadlineJob?.cancel() recoveryDeadlineJob = null openTransportLocked(preserveTurns = false) true } suspend fun disconnect() = serialized { desiredConnection = false reconnectBlocked = false pairingCode = null isManualPairingAttempt = false reconnectJob?.cancel() reconnectJob = null recoveryDeadlineJob?.cancel() recoveryDeadlineJob = null connectionAttemptTimeoutJob?.cancel() connectionAttemptTimeoutJob = null connectionGeneration += 1 clearConnectionWorkLocked() runCatching { transport.close() } mutableState.value = mutableState.value.copy( connection = GatewayConnectionState.DISCONNECTED, reconnectAttempt = 0, lastError = null ) val stored = preferences.load() preferences.update(stored.copy(automaticallyConnect = false)) ```
**依据 2 · 源码核查**：[shared/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/clarklevis/dsh/shared/gateway/GatewayRuntime.kt:358-378](https://github.com/Clarklevis1995/dsh-mobile/blob/1fa7aa7e2d3f50379d37fba251fb6e774416703b/shared/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/clarklevis/dsh/shared/gateway/GatewayRuntime.kt#L358-L378) 消息输入限制和请求ID传递。
查看原文（21行） ```text suspend fun sendMessage( text: String, images: List, sessionId: String?, workspaceId: String?, clientTimeZone: String, mode: String = "queue", receipts: List = emptyList(), requestId: String? = null ): Boolean = serialized { if (text.isBlank() && images.isEmpty() && receipts.isEmpty()) return@serialized false if (!outgoingImagesAreWithinLimits(images)) { rejectLocked("message", ERROR_IMAGE_LIMITS) return@serialized false } markTurnLocked(sessionId) val sent = sendRequestLocked( GatewayRequests.message(text.trim(), images, sessionId, workspaceId, clientTimeZone, mode, receipts, requestId) ) if (!sent) releaseTurnLocked(sessionId) sent ```
**依据 3 · 源码核查**：[shared/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/clarklevis/dsh/shared/gateway/GatewayRuntime.kt:404-468](https://github.com/Clarklevis1995/dsh-mobile/blob/1fa7aa7e2d3f50379d37fba251fb6e774416703b/shared/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/clarklevis/dsh/shared/gateway/GatewayRuntime.kt#L404-L468) 连接守卫、通道队列与传输发送结果。
